page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a KVM hypervisor. Network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities. The instance achieves top-tier results in multi-threaded workloads, as demonstrated by strong performance in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory subsystem performance is also notable, with large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching 209.21 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% of tested configurations. Extended instruction execution, including AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI, shows high efficiency. However, single-core execution and text generation for large language models represent relative performance bottlenecks, scoring in the average and lower quartiles respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfc6.16xlarge offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated CPU allocation, making it highly suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The strong performance in database operations and multi-threaded processing makes this instance well-suited for high-throughput web serving, database management, parallel data decompression, and compilation tasks.
